title: Jalen Rose Rips Marcus Jordan & Larsa Pippen's Relationship In Recent Episode Of Jalen & Jacoby
htmlContent:
In what made a lot of headlines recently, Larsa Pippen, the ex-wife of Hall of Famer Scottie Pippen, reportedly dated Michael Jordan's son Marcus.

Of course, Scottie Pippen and Jordan were teammates with the Chicago Bulls for many years and won six titles together. They are probably one of the greatest duets in NBA history.

Due to the history between Scottie Pippen and Michael Jordan, many believe that the romantic relationship between Larsa Pippen and the young Jordan is a bit strange and inappropriate.

NBA analyst Jalen Rose recently offered his viewpoint on the issue, blasting Larsa Pippen into the process.

“Certain relationships used to be off limits,” Rose started. “And I, on paper, want everybody to be happy and to live their best life. But, the best thing I can say for her is she should see him as more of a nephew than a mate.”

While some might view the relationship as odd, both people seem to do what makes them happy. They cannot be blamed for that.

Larsa Pippen and young Jordan recently attended a Los Angeles Chargers game together, with the 48-year-old getting heckled by someone else watching the game.

While everyone is entitled to their own opinion, it seems a bit unnecessary to heckle Larsa Pippen during one of her outings with the young Jordan. They seemed to take it lightly and didn't seem to be too concerned about it, but it also seemed to make them a little uncomfortable.

As long as the two are together, people will likely continue to chime in and offer thoughts on their relationship. One can only imagine if the elder Jordan and Scottie Pippen have spoken about their relationship.

Scottie Pippen spent most of her career with Michael Jordan in the Bulls. He finished his career as a six-time champion and seven-time all-star with 16.1 points, 6.4 rebounds, and 5.2 assists per game.
